operations.name: cloud.auth.status
operations.docs: Whether cmux is signed in to cmux Cloud and which team requests use. cmux answers from its own sign-in; the app server never sees a token.

operations.name: cloud.machine.list

items.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

operations.docs: List your Cloud machines and refresh the machine projection on this Mac. Read on page open, app activation and after every change; there is no polling. Alias: vm.list.

operations.name: cloud.machine.watch
operations.docs: The machine change stream. The catalog has no stream class yet, so this read answers the current projection revision; the server then sends cloud.machine.watch events after each op: {type: upsert, revision, machine} or {type: removed, revision, id}. One revision per projection change; no timer, no polling.

operations.name: cloud.machine.get

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

operations.docs: Read one machine and update it in the projection. Alias: vm.get.

operations.name: cloud.machine.create

displayName.description: Display name: 1 to 64 characters, no control characters.

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

title.ja: 新しいクラウドマシン

operations.docs: Create a machine. Needs an idempotency key: a retry with the same key returns the same machine and never creates a second one. Uses your plan quota. Alias: vm.create.

operations.name: cloud.machine.rename

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

operations.docs: Rename a machine; an empty name clears it. Alias: vm.update.

operations.name: cloud.machine.start

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

title.ja: クラウドマシンを起動

operations.docs: Start (resume) a paused machine. The server also accepts cloud.machine.resume, vm.start and vm.resume.

operations.name: cloud.machine.pause

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

title.ja: クラウドマシンを一時停止

operations.docs: Pause a machine. Its disk and sessions are kept. Alias: vm.pause.

operations.name: cloud.machine.resize

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

operations.docs: Resize a machine: cpu 1-32, memoryMb 4096-65536 in whole GiB, storageMb in 4 GiB steps up to 256 GiB. The result shows the plan limits. Alias: vm.resize.

operations.name: cloud.machine.delete

title.ja: クラウドマシンを削除…

operations.docs: Delete a machine and its disk. Only a person may delete: the host stamps origin user only after its native confirmation sheet; every other origin gets cmux.cloud.origin_refused. Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP. Alias: vm.delete.

operations.name: cloud.machine.stats
operations.docs: Live CPU, memory and disk of a machine. A sleeping machine answers without being woken.

operations.name: cloud.machine.idle_policy.set
operations.docs: Set when an idle machine pauses (seconds of idle time, 0 = never). Not served yet: the cmux Cloud API has no idle policy route, so the server answers cmux.cloud.unsupported. Hidden on the CLI and MCP until the route exists.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.list
operations.docs: Snapshots of a machine, newest first. Alias: vm.snapshot.list.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.create

name.description: Display name: 1 to 64 characters, no control characters.

title.ja: クラウドマシンのスナップショットを作成

operations.docs: Take a snapshot of a machine. Alias: vm.snapshot.create.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.restore

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

operations.docs: Create a new machine from a snapshot. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the same machine. Alias: vm.snapshot.restore.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.fork

name.description: Display name: 1 to 64 characters, no control characters.

output.description: A Cloud machine record (owner: the cmux Cloud API).

snapshotId.description: The snapshot the copy was made from.

revision.description: The machine projection revision this change reached; the change shows on cloud.machine.watch at this revision or later.

title.ja: クラウドマシンをフォーク

operations.docs: Fork a machine: snapshot it and start a copy. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the same copy.

operations.name: cloud.snapshot.delete
operations.docs: Delete a snapshot of a machine. Only a person may delete (origin user, stamped by the host after its native confirmation). Hidden on the CLI and never on MCP. Alias: vm.snapshot.delete.

operations.name: cloud.plan.get
operations.docs: Your plan: machine limit, active machines, memory sizes the plan includes and the plan that adds larger ones. Read from the cmux Cloud API; cmux keeps no plan logic.

operations.name: cloud.usage.get
operations.docs: Machine hours used and included in this period (plans with an hour allowance) and the saved machine limit.

operations.name: cloud.machine.connect

carrier.description: cloud-vm/<machine>#<generation>; a new id after each reconnect.

socket.description: The link's local socket (owner-only directory) until the host passes a carrier fd.

title.ja: クラウドマシンに接続

operations.docs: Open the one private link (carrier) to a machine and return it. A second call while the link is up returns the same carrier and starts no new link. A paused machine is started first. Not a focus change. When the link goes down nothing reconnects by itself and nothing queues: call connect again, also with the same key: connect is never replayed from the ledger.

operations.name: cloud.machine.disconnect

title.ja: クラウドマシンから切断

operations.docs: End the link to a machine and forget it, also after a revocation. Every terminal of that machine on this Mac shows the disconnected state. The machine keeps running.

operations.name: cloud.rescue.open

focus.description: Focus the new terminal. Origin user always focuses it.

title.ja: クラウド救援シェルを開く

operations.docs: Open a shell on a machine whose cmux daemon does not answer (the cmux.terminal.backend/1 rescue kind). The new terminal gets focus only for origin user or focus true (focuses stays false: focus is not the op's purpose). Answers cmux.cloud.unsupported until the cmux Cloud API has an interactive shell route.
